name: akbun-draw
description: Image drawing skills by akbun — image-generation prompts and editable SVGs in fixed akbun styles

interface.shortDescription: Image drawing skills in fixed akbun styles
interface.longDescription: Image drawing skills that turn any subject, story, or code into image-generation prompts (GPT image, nano-banana, etc.) and Figma/Canva-editable SVGs, each in a fixed akbun illustration style — webtoons, posters, card news, hand-drawn doodle motion graphics and 2/4/6-panel doodle comics, and the akbun whale mascot spec.
defaultPrompt: Draw this script as night-gouache explainer scenes (dark painted illustrations with one glowing highlight) and export the layers for Resolve
Make an image prompt that explains this code as a blog figure
Make a hand-drawn doodle motion graphic (pose swaps, draw-on lines and text) as MP4 or transparent MOV and place it on my Resolve timeline at 12s
Make a code-window motion graphic: type this function line by line in a white editor window and highlight the line I talk about (akbun-draw-code-window-lilac)
Make a pencil-analogy scene that explains caching with a stick figure, one colored prop and falling tags, timed to my script (akbun-draw-pencil-analogy-graphite)
Make a colored-pencil storybook scene that explains a message queue with characters and a red dashed warning, timed to my script (akbun-draw-storybook-crayon)
Make a child-like crayon diagram image prompt (wobbly double outlines, scribble fill, gray dashed standby parts) for this system flow (akbun-draw-crayon-milo)
Make a pastel animal-character webtoon page (image prompts + Figma/Canva SVG) from these images and story
Make a 4-panel doodle comic from this story as Instagram carousel images (1080x1350) with reading-order numbers
Make a grayscale documentary-style webtoon with subtitle narration (per-scene image prompts) from my story
Make a pencil sketchbook concept-card image prompt for this topic
Make a cream handwritten explainer card-news (image prompt + Figma/Canva SVG) for this concept
Make a quiet cream pencil-sketch scene image prompt with one teal accent from this moment
Describe the akbun whale mascot character spec for use in another drawing skill
